messages:
Maya R.: heads-up: building a compact benchmark narrative for next week's launch. goal = 1pager + 90s post + one-click playground. want a unique visual that isn't just scatter plots. ideas? :bulb:
Ben C.: what about a 3-panel micro-card: left = violin of cost-per-token distribution (shows variance), middle = p50 vs seq-length line, right = throughput-per-dollar stacked bars. compact & tells the variance story.
Leah T.: love the violin idea. helps call out "long-tail variability" which is core to our routing pitch. i'll draft microcopy: HEAD: "Right-size inference: control cost without compromising latency." sub: "Routing + quantization reduce long-sequence spend by ~3x; preserve chat latency."
Nate H.: data ready. BenchAgent exported runs for redwood-std / openfam-llama / baseline-commercial across seqs 32,128,512,2048. includes p50,p95,cost_per_1k_tokens,tokens_per_usd. uploading CSV.
BenchAgent: export: https://internal.redwood/exports/1736504321/bench_v5.csv :file_cabinet:
Maya R.: copy note: use conservative language on multiples: "up to 3x" and include config footnote. Leah, can you craft CTAs? We need 1) playground (self-serve) 2) speak-to-sales (dedicated trial) 3) webinar sign-up (deep dive).
Leah T.: CTAs drafted: "Try the latency-cost playground", "Request a dedicated trial", "Join the benchmark deep-dive webinar". will include quick bullets for each CTA.
Ben C.: visual callouts: annotate violin tops to show tail spend, add tiny table below showing test config (HW model quant, batch size). export as svg/png. will include an accessibility-friendly alt text.
Nate H.: numbers quick preview: 2048 seq: q4 + batch8 -> tokens_per_usd = 3.1x vs baseline float32 no-batch. p50 improves mildly with batching due to KV cache warmup; p95 increases for batch8. will attach verification table.
Maya R.: marketing ask: keep headline measurable and engineer-friendly. avoid marketing-speak. also add a one-line "what engineers should care" for the post.
Leah T.: drafting 90s post draft now: will keep it tight. also adding a 1-paragraph sales playbook with two recommended presets: "balanced" (p50-centered) and "tail-guarded" (p95-centered).
Ben C.: timeline: mockup by today 3pm, final assets by tomorrow 11am. Nate: final numbers + appendix by EOD.
BenchAgent: p95 tail simulations queued for batch8; ETA 2h.
Maya R.: perfect. we'll review in dry-run Wednesday 9am. keep thread for updates only. :rocket:
